name: Process Execution — Run Now Button + Manual Trigger

content.description: Add a 'Run Now' button to each process in the Process Hub. Clicking opens a modal with optional entity type, entity ID, and context JSON fields. Submitting calls POST /api/v1/process-engine/instances to create a process instance with steps derived from the process's aiProcessingSteps + humanTouchpoints. Shows confirmation with instance ID and link to process monitor page. Also add 'Execute Flow' button on E2E flows.

run_now_modal.trigger: Play/Run button on each process detail panel in the Process Hub
run_now_modal.submit_action: POST /api/v1/process-engine/instances with processId, processName, triggerType='manual', steps derived from process data
run_now_modal.success: Show toast 'Process started' with instance ID, link to /processes/monitor
run_now_modal.steps_derivation: Map aiProcessingSteps to stepName with executorType='ai', then append humanTouchpoints as executorType='human' steps

e2e_run_button.description: Add 'Execute Flow' button on each E2E flow card. Creates parent process instance with steps from flow.steps array. Each step gets executorType from step.type (ai/human/system).

acceptance_criteria: Each process in Process Hub has a 'Run' button visible in the summary row
Clicking 'Run' opens a modal with optional entity type (select), entity ID (text), and context (textarea)
Submitting the modal calls POST /api/v1/process-engine/instances with correct payload
Steps are derived from process aiProcessingSteps (executorType='ai') + humanTouchpoints (executorType='human')
triggerType is set to 'manual' for all Run Now executions
processId and processName match the clicked process
On success: modal closes, toast shows 'Process {processName} started' with link to monitor
On error: modal shows error message, does not close
E2E flows have 'Execute Flow' button that creates instance with flow steps
Modal includes CSRF token in request headers
Modal validates entityId as UUID format if provided
Dark mode support on modal and button
edge_cases: Process with zero aiProcessingSteps — should not happen (all 227 have steps), but show error if so
Invalid UUID for entityId — show validation error in modal
Invalid JSON in contextJson textarea — show parse error
API returns 429 rate limit — show 'Too many requests, try again later'
API returns 403 no permission — show 'You do not have permission to run processes'
Network error — show generic error message
User clicks Run while another process is starting — disable button during submission
error_handling: API errors: parse error response and display message in modal
Network errors: show 'Unable to connect. Please try again.'
Validation errors: highlight invalid fields with red border and message
security_considerations: CSRF token required on POST request (X-CSRF-Token header)
Auth required — API route checks session
Input sanitized via Zod on API side
content.implementation_notes: Create a RunProcessButton client component at src/components/processes/run-process-button.tsx. It renders a small Play icon button in the process summary row. On click, opens a dialog/modal. Modal form submits via fetch() to /api/v1/process-engine/instances. The component receives processId, processName, aiProcessingSteps, humanTouchpoints as props. Steps are built client-side: aiProcessingSteps.map((s,i) => ({stepNumber: i+1, stepName: s, executorType: 'ai'})) then append humanTouchpoints. Import this component into processes/page.tsx. For the E2E Execute Flow, create a similar RunE2EFlowButton. Use the existing Dialog/Modal from Radix UI if available, otherwise a simple fixed overlay.
affected_files: src/components/processes/run-process-button.tsx — NEW: Run Now button + modal component
src/components/processes/run-e2e-flow-button.tsx — NEW: Execute Flow button for E2E flows
src/app/(dashboard)/processes/page.tsx — add Run buttons to process rows and E2E cards
testing_requirements: Run button appears on each process detail summary
E2E Execute Flow button creates instance with correct steps
